name: Audiorama Chapultepec: Sound Refuge of Ahuehuetes
name_es: Audiorama Chapultepec: El refugio del silencio
description: Botanical sound sanctuary shaded by century-old ahuehuetes at the foot of Chapultepec Hill, calibrated for deep listening of classical music and jazz with strict community silence.
golden_spot_tips: Blue armchair facing the volcanic grotto, which acts as an acoustic reflector filtering out metropolitan traffic.

name: Huerto Roma Verde: Bioclimatic Permaculture Sanctuary
name_es: Huerto Roma Verde: Laboratorio de resiliencia comunitaria
description: Urban agroecological oasis with bamboo geodesic domes, medicinal gardens, and stingless melipona bee sanctuaries providing organic acoustic calm in dense Roma Sur.
golden_spot_tips: Melipona bee pavilion at solar noon under warm filtered sunlight.

name: Kiosko Morisco: Geometric Neo-Mudejar Pavilion
name_es: Kiosko Morisco: La joya geométrica de Santa María
description: Intricate 19th-century cast-iron octagonal structure by José Ramón Ibarrola, blending Islamic Alhambra geometry with industrial metallurgy in a peaceful neighborhood grove.
golden_spot_tips: Center axis looking directly into the dome lattice between 11:00 AM and 1:00 PM.

name: Parque México: Art Deco Elliptical Canopy
name_es: Parque México: El oasis elíptico de la Condesa
description: Lush 9-hectare park preserved on the former 1927 Jockey Club racetrack, featuring Lindbergh Forum Art Deco pillars and dense bamboo groves dampening street reverberations.
golden_spot_tips: Lindbergh Forum behind the Cántaros fountain during late afternoon side-lighting.

name: Las Islas UNAM: Volcanic Pedregal & Modernist Campus
name_es: Las Islas de CU: Paisaje volcánico y patrimonio moderno
description: UNESCO World Heritage open esplanade combining Mario Pani modernist architecture, Juan O'Gorman mineral stone murals, and natural basaltic volcanic grounds.
golden_spot_tips: North lawn facing the Central Library mural during golden sunset light.

name: Desierto de los Leones: Carmelite Cloister in Cloud Forest
name_es: Ex-Convento del Desierto de los Leones: El susurro del bosque
description: 17th-century Discalced Carmelite monastery immersed in high-altitude oyamel fir forests and mountain mist; absolute acoustic isolation and crystalline stream sounds.
golden_spot_tips: Capilla de los Secretos acoustic chamber with mountain fog drifting through high windows.

name: Biblioteca Vasconcelos: Suspended Crystal Ark
name_es: Biblioteca Vasconcelos: El arca de cristal en CDMX
description: Monumental matrix of suspended steel and glass bookshelves designed by Alberto Kalach, enveloped by a 26,000 sqm endemic botanical garden and profound contemplative quietude.
golden_spot_tips: Level 7 north mezzanine overlooking Gabriel Orozco's whale matrix at 4:30 PM.

name: Coyoacán: Francisco Sosa Cobblestone Corridor
name_es: Coyoacán: Callejones de Frida y Plaza Conchita
description: Colonial river-stone avenue bordered by bougainvillea-draped volcanic walls, century-old ash trees, and intimate courtyards shielded from commercial retail noise.
golden_spot_tips: Center of Plaza de la Conchita as warm light hits the baroque facade at 6:15 PM.

name: Plaza San Jacinto: Courtyards & Magnolia Quietude
name_es: Plaza de San Jacinto (San Ángel): El jardín de los artistas
description: Historic San Ángel village square with stone water fountains, quiet shaded cloisters, open-air painter studios, and scent of jacaranda and fresh high-altitude coffee.
golden_spot_tips: Front fountain facing the 16th-century Carmen monastery walls at 2:00 PM.

name: Plaza Santo Domingo: Scribes & Analog Portals
name_es: Plaza de Santo Domingo: Los portales de la memoria
description: Historic viceregal arcades preserving the century-old living tradition of typographic letterpresses and public scribes, providing an authentic analog refuge in the city core.
golden_spot_tips: South arcade center beneath stone arches at 11:30 AM listening to mechanical keystrokes.

name: Xochimilco Dawn: Zero-Emission Chinampa Sanctuary
name_es: Xochimilco Privado: Protocolo de canales y niebla al alba
description: Exclusive sunrise navigation in private electric/poled trajinera through ancient pre-Hispanic agricultural canals, viewing herons, ahuejote trees, and morning lake mist.
golden_spot_tips: Main canal reserve junction as solar angle reaches 10 degrees creating pure mirror reflections.

name: Teotihuacán Sunrise: Aerostatic Hot Air Flight
name_es: Teotihuacán: Vuelo en globo al amanecer sobre las pirámides
description: Silent thermal ascension above the Pyramids of the Sun and Moon during dawn's first light, experiencing the monumental geometric axis from calm airspace.
golden_spot_tips: Direct zenith above the Pyramid of the Sun when long morning shadows align on the Avenue of the Dead.

name: Pujol & Quintonil: Biodynamic High Gastronomy
name_es: Pujol & Quintonil: El olimpo de la alta cocina mexicana
description: Slow sensory dining ritual centered on ancestral heirloom corn from Xochimilco chinampas, native wild quelites, and bioclimatic architecture enveloped in soft acoustic intimacy.
golden_spot_tips: Taco Omakase bar right corner overlooking culinary team coordination under warm pinpoint illumination.

name: Museo Nacional de Antropología: The Umbrella Fountain
name_es: Museo Nacional de Antropología: El oráculo del tiempo prehispánico
description: Pedro Ramírez Vázquez architectural masterpiece featuring the monumental bronze central waterfall 'El Paraguas', offering white noise acoustic protection before entering monumental halls.
golden_spot_tips: Central courtyard rim beneath the waterfall veil at 10:00 AM.

name: Templo Mayor: The Sacred Axis of Tenochtitlan
name_es: Templo Mayor: El corazón sagrado del Imperio Mexica
description: Elevated footbridges suspended above superimposed archaeological strata where the four cardinal directions of the Mexica cosmos converged, crowned by the Coyolxauhqui monolith.
golden_spot_tips: Elevated museum overlook facing the archaeological pyramid ruins at noon.
